headlines.title: Ticks that cause Lyme and other diseases have migrated south. Are doctors ready?
headlines.description: New research from the CDC finds that ticks that cause diseases keep marching into new areas.

headlines.title: Pregnant women having to travel further to deliver
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on how hospitals across the country have been closing labor and delivery units, meaning more women have to travel further to deliver their babies. In Lincoln County, Maine, the only delivery unit is set to close later this year, leaving expectant mothers scrambling.

headlines.title: Custody battle between biological parents and surrogate
headlines.description: The biological parents of a baby boy, born via surrogate, are fighting for custody after the gestational carrier refused to have an abortion when they learned about a serious heart defect at 20 weeks pregnant. Instead, the Alaska based surrogate fled to Texas where she carried the baby to term, and is now fighting for parental rights. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler has the latest.

headlines.title: New CDC data reveals ticks have migrated south, possibly creating more risks for Lyme disease
headlines.description: New research from the CDC reveals ticks have migrated south, possibly creating more risks for Lyme disease. The spread is testing doctors' preparedness as diagnoses outside the Northeast become more common. NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Teen Dies From Irregular Heartbeat After Taking GLP-1: Report
headlines.description: UK media are reporting that a 19-year-old American college student died in her dorm room last year after taking a GLP-1 weight loss drug. Court papers show that Josephine Nassar died from a fatal irregular heartbeat triggered in part by the GLP-1 and a heart condition that she apparently had been born with.

headlines.title: 21 products you actually need when your kid starts school for the first time — from a mom of 3
headlines.description: A mom of three researched, shopped and tested back-to-school gear for her kid who’s going to Pre-K for the first time. Here, she shares the best products for parents who want quality, including backpacks, lunch boxes, clothing, tech and organization essentials worth buying before the year starts.

headlines.title: The best derm-approved spray deodorants in 2026
headlines.description: Spray deodorants are lightweight, refreshing and effective — shop expert-recommended picks from Secret, Dove, Lume and more.

headlines.title: How often do you really need to wash your jean shorts? Experts weigh in
headlines.description: Learn how to wash jean shorts the right way, including how often to wash them, the best detergent, drying tips, and a clever freezer trick — straight from denim experts.

headlines.title: Salehe Bembury New Balance sneakers are up to 63% off — but your size is selling out fast
headlines.description: Salehe Bembury’s New Balance 1000 sneakers are 62% off during the Archive Sale, which includes deals on previous collabs from New Balance, Crocs and more.

headlines.title: Trump signs executive order aiming to cut the number of required vaccines for children
headlines.description: The order reaffirms the dramatic overhaul to the vaccine schedule that Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced this year. Those changes have been blocked in court.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
headlines.description: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.
